{{Quote|Get behind me. I'll take care of these bounty hunters.|[[Rachi Sitra]]|<ref name="SWGTCG:GHDS" />}}
A '''diplomatic mission''' to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] was undertaken by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Rachi Sitra]] sometime after the [[battle of Talus]]. However, the mission was foiled, because when Sitra's shuttle jumped into [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] space, it was ambushed by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]'s [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. Fett and a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] intended to claim [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] in Sitra's head. Fett ambushed the shuttle from behind an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], then, with a precise shot from a heavy blaster cannon, neutralized the shuttle's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and commenced boarding actions. When the airlock was forced open, Sitra ignited her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and prepared to defend herself. Fett began the firefight by firing a rocket from his [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist launcher]]. Then another bounty hunter knocked Sitra's lightsaber out of her hands. Bruised and battered, the Jedi had no choice but to surrender herself to the bounty hunter; Fett locked [[Energy binder/Legends|energy binders]] on her hands and prepared to deliver her to Imperial authorities.<ref name="SWGTCG:GHDS" />
